comment: The tool-aware build, against tool_ops.json on tool_scene.xyz with tool_dump.xyz on feedstocks and tool_tip.xyz / tool_probe.xyz on tools. It abstracts, recharges on the reservoir, abstracts again, abstracts with the bare probe, settles, then exposes both carbons - so one script covers all three methods, both tool types, a state round trip and a two-step bulk event. Seven keys per step at most: `method` is the operation's now.

steps.note: the charged tip takes methane A's +z hydrogen and goes spent
the recharge: the spent tip dumps its hydrogen on the reservoir
the recharged tip takes a second hydrogen of methane A
the same abstraction on methane B, by the bare probe
methane A relaxes into the two vacancies
one site's share of the X2 dose
the other site's share of the same dose - one event with the step before it
